desktop.notesZh: 批次二十（变更总览 / 变更详情 / 确认门三页 UI 升级 + 测试流页签移位，web 真机探针验证）：① 变更总览页改「金箔仪表台」风格——BAF 徽标 + 台账标题区、四块带金线的图表面板（进行中 / 已完成 / 已放弃 / 任务进度）、变更卡片改为金色发丝边圆角浮面（状态色左条、任务进度条、悬停抬升与金色光晕）；② 变更详情重建为四区工作区——顶部条（变更 ID / 模式 / 状态 / 开始时间 / 耗时 / Tokens）、左侧固定栏（变更分类 + 阶段产物）、中间完整工作流图、右侧栏（阶段抬头 + 阶段门禁清单 + 阶段详情 + 完整事件历史）；中间的工作流图与会话「工作流图」页共用同一个画布组件（节点、连线、状态色、产物 chip 完全一致，画布箭头 marker 改为每实例唯一）；③ 确认门页 UI 升级，沿用同一套金色材质与动效语言（分层表面 + 金色发丝边 + 顶部高光 + 错峰淡入 + 悬停抬升）；④ 测试流页签从「企业规范」之后移到「确认门」与「指令集」之间。
desktop.notesEn: Batch twenty (the change-ledger / change-detail / confirm-gate surfaces get the gold-foil console UI + the test-flow tab moves; web probe verified): (1) The change ledger became a gold-foil console — the BAF mark and ledger title band, four figure plates with gold rules (active / completed / abandoned / tasks), and the change cards rebuilt as rounded floating plates with hairline gold edges (a state-coloured left bar, a task progress rail, a hover lift and a gold glow). (2) The change detail was rebuilt as a four-zone workspace — a top strip (change id, mode, state, start time, duration, tokens), a fixed LEFT rail (the change classification and the stage artifacts), the COMPLETE workflow graph in the middle, and a RIGHT rail (the stage head, the stage checklist, the stage detail and the full event history). The middle graph now shares ONE canvas component with the session workflow tab, so the nodes, edges, status colours and artifact chips are identical (the canvas arrow marker became per-instance unique). (3) The confirm-gate page got the same gold material and motion language (layered surfaces, hairline gold edges, a lit top edge, staggered entrances, hover lift). (4) The test-flow tab moved from after the enterprise-standards tab to between the confirm-gate and the commands tabs.
